name: Spencer Gore
bio: Spencer Frederick Gore was a British painter of landscapes, music-hall scenes and interiors, usually with single figures. He was the first president of the Camden Town Group, and was influenced by the Post-Impressionists.

paintings.title: Letchworth Station (painting)
paintings.story: Letchworth Station is a 1912 landscape painting by the British artist Spencer Gore. It features a view of Letchworth Garden City railway station in Hertfordshire. The station had been built a few years earlier to serve the new garden city of Letchworth.
